lessonTitle: 74. Proportional segments in a right triangle
lessonTitleEnglish: Proportional segments in a right triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The height CH from the right angle splits the triangle into two triangles similar to each other and to the whole.
stages.headlineEnglish: The height CH from the right angle splits the triangle into two triangles similar to each other and to the whole.

stages.headline: The height is the mean proportional of the hypotenuse segments: CH² = AH · HB; AH = 4, HB = 9 give CH = 6.
stages.headlineEnglish: The height is the mean proportional of the hypotenuse segments: CH² = AH · HB; AH = 4, HB = 9 give CH = 6.

stages.headline: A leg is the mean proportional of the hypotenuse and its projection: AC² = AB · AH, BC² = AB · HB.
stages.headlineEnglish: A leg is the mean proportional of the hypotenuse and its projection: AC² = AB · AH, BC² = AB · HB.
